name: vivreal-ads
description: Vivreal's paid-ads knowledge and workflow, starting with Google Ads. Captures the account's real structure (campaigns, conversion actions, GA4/GTM linkage), the conversion-tracking gotchas that block a test from measuring anything real, and the creative conventions (image generation via Google Flow, representation rules for geo-targeted creative, never faking product UI) learned while running the account. Grows as more campaigns are run and more channels are added.
